title: Food and Cooking

story.title: Cooking plov with Grandma
story.text: Every Sunday, Aziza cooks with her grandma. Last Sunday, Grandma said, “Today I’ll teach you my famous plov **recipe**!” | First, they bought the **ingredients** at the market: **meat**, **rice**, carrots, onions and some other **vegetables**. | At home, Aziza **cut** the onions and carrots – she cried a lot because of the onions! Grandma **fried** the meat in a big pot. Then they **added** the onions, the carrots and some salt. After that, they **boiled** some water and added the **rice**. | While the plov was cooking, Grandma **baked** fresh **bread**. The kitchen smelled wonderful, and Aziza **was** very **hungry**. | Finally, the plov was ready. The whole family said it was **delicious** – not too **salty** and not too **spicy**. For dessert they had **fruit** and some **sweets** with green tea. | Aziza’s brother usually eats **junk food** and **orders** pizza, but that day he said, “Plov is my favourite **dish** now!”

answers: Can you cook? What can you make?
Yes, a little. **I can cook** fried eggs and soup **quite well**. **For example**, last Sunday I made soup for my family and they said it was **delicious**.
What is a traditional dish in your country?
The most famous dish is plov. **It’s made with** rice, meat, carrots and onions. **In my country, people usually eat** plov **for** lunch, especially at weddings.
speech: Hello everyone! I want to talk about my favourite dish. **My favourite dish is** manti. **It’s made with** meat, onions and a thin dough. My mum cooks it every Friday. I can help her: **first**, we cut the meat and onions. **Then**, we put them in the dough. **Finally**, we cook them with steam for forty minutes. They are really delicious! **I’m not a big fan of** spicy food, so I eat manti with yoghurt. **I’m trying to eat more healthily**, so I don’t eat much junk food. Thank you!
